market_context.rate_regime_note: Strong payrolls lifted September rate-HIKE odds. 2-year yield hit its highest since Jan 2025. This is a tightening-scare tape, not a cutting tape.
market_context.dispersion_note: Indices closed red while semi-cap equipment / memory closed +7% to +12%. That divergence -- not the index print -- is the tradeable fact of the session.

regulatory_context.pdt_note: SEC approved removal of the $25,000 PDT minimum on 2026-04-14; FINRA set 2026-06-04 as the effective date. The $25k equity floor, the 4-trades-in-5-days counter and the 90-day freeze are gone, replaced by a risk-based intraday margin framework. Broker-dealers have an 18-month phase-in, so HOUSE requirements still vary -- confirm with the broker before sizing.
regulatory_context.consequence: The T+1 cash-account capital-partition model (fixed $4,000 per trade, risk cut to 0.20-0.50%) that one research source built the plan around is obsolete. On a margin account, size on RISK, not on settled-cash partitions.
